correctness.rationale: All fourteen facets are explicitly classified in two open chambers and at c=2. Their support heights, areas, adjacency, ridge lengths, normal angles, masses and conductances give a seven-dimensional even graph quotient. Three diagonal contrasts, two axial contrasts and two class-constant eigenvectors span it and yield all eigenvalues. Exact rational 14-facet verification with 11 test parameters reproduced each eigenvector equation, and an independent planar hull computation verified facet areas. The positive ordering, root of 3c^2-7c+3, derivative signs, and exact maximum follow algebraically; finite tests are not treated as a proof of all real c.

value.rationale: For the natural three-dimensional interpolation between the two extremal regular polar polytopes, the claim classifies all seven even eigenmodes through a geometric-combinatorial transition and identifies a sharp, genuinely interior algebraic optimizer. The eigengap is not monotone, its minimizing eigenspace changes multiplicity at a non-combinatorial crossing, and the precise maximum is 1+sqrt(13). These are motivated structural/spectral benchmarks, not a single arbitrarily selected numeric instance or routine endpoint re-evaluation.
